description: List the workspaces this account can access, with their ids; the current (default) one is marked. Tools default to the current workspace, so you only need `workspace` to target a different one.
name: list_workspaces

current_workspace.description: Id of the workspace tools default to.

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (the result is also flagged isError).

cause.description: Machine-readable failure category: invalid_argument, not_found, forbidden, plan_limit, rate_limited, or server_error.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same call could succeed.
